Recreate recovery cursor from the last confirmed point.

detaileddescription.para: That is used by Raft, when the node becomes a leader. It may happen, that it already sent some data to other nodes as a follower, and they ignored the data. Now when the node is a leader, it should send the not confirmed data again. Otherwise the cluster will stuck, or worse - the newer data would be sent without the older sent but ignored data.
